messages:
ana: Quick prototype: small 'Inspector' micro-snapshot on saved queries showing route->model, variant, policy_hint, quota_bucket, sampling_pct, est_tokens_min. Aim: fast UI with optional heavy materialize.
vik: Agree. Savedview stores tiny preview + inspector_ref. Console fetches inspector when user opens or asks to export.
drew: API suggestion: POST /api/inspector/materialize (returns job_id + cost_est_cents), GET /api/inspector/{id} returns preview + is_materialized + size_bytes + telemetry_refs.
ana: UX: show small diff button when snapshot policy differs from current route policy. Also show 'materialize for export' CTA with cost estimate.
vik: Retention: materialized TTL default 90 days, micro-preview retained with savedview indefinitely. Admins can change TTL.
infra-bot: infra note: materialize jobs queued, cost-guardrails required; avoid running during blackout windows.
drew: I'll draft schema and PR. vik: I'll update Console mocks. ana: Happy with that plan.
